title: Lazy-Sunday Portuguese Samphire Grill
description: Tangy and shattering, this keto-friendly dish features samphire and lamination-puff, perfect for a relaxing Sunday evening.
instructions: Rinse the samphire and pat dry with a paper towel.
Roll out the lamination-puff pastry to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Cut the pastry into 4 equal rectangles, about 4 inches (10 cm) wide and 6 inches (15 cm) long.
Place a tablespoon of olive oil on one half of each rectangle, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Sprinkle minced garlic over the oil, followed by a sprinkle of salt.
Top with the other half of the pastry, pressing the edges to seal.
Cut a small slit in the top of each pastry rectangle to allow steam to escape.
Place the samphire on top of the pastry, folding the leaves slightly to fit.
Brush the tops with the beaten egg and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Place the pastries on the preheated raclette grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
